_about: Composer slices for the phase-2 curation agents (data/chamber/curation/AGENT_BRIEF.md), generated by scripts/chamber/curation_slices.ts from the census. works = in-scope IMSLP works of the slice (vocal and viol-consort works, which wait for the owner's decision, are in 'open'); recorded = works IMSLP links to a commercial recording. A composer with 'formations' is split across slices by formation.
